resources.string: Crash countdown and SOS result. Sound and location are visible on the lock screen.
No SIM, or no default SMS SIM is selected; the emergency SMS cannot be sent. Automatic crash detection and the SOS button stay off.
SMS permission was denied permanently. Grant it from the phone settings.
The crash countdown will not show on the lock screen. The voice alert and the SMS still work.
The countdown needs notification permission to appear on the lock screen. The voice alert and the SMS still work without it.
The countdown will not open full screen on the lock screen. The notification, voice alert and SMS still work.
